datasets.name: ds_producao_mensal
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f.unit_name,
    to_date(concat(k.ano_mes, '-01')) AS mes,
    k.energia_kwh,
    k.kwh_por_kwp,
    k.leituras_com_falha,
    MAX(to_date(concat(k.ano_mes, '-01'))) OVER () AS ref
  FROM
    workspace.curated.kpi_producao_filial_mes k
      JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f USING (company_unit_key)
  WHERE
    ( :filial IS NULL OR f.unit_name = :filial )
)
SELECT
  unit_name,
  mes,
  energia_kwh,
  kwh_por_kwp,
  leituras_com_falha,
  CASE
    WHEN mes = ref THEN energia_kwh
  END AS energia_mes_atual,
  CASE
    WHEN mes = add_months(ref, -1) THEN energia_kwh
  END AS energia_mes_anterior
FROM
  base

datasets.name: ds_saude_cards
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f.unit_name,
    k.full_date,
    k.saude_media,
    MAX(k.full_date) OVER () AS ref
  FROM
    workspace.curated.kpi_saude_diaria_filial k
      JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f USING (company_unit_key)
  WHERE
    f.unit_name = :filial
)
SELECT
  unit_name,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN saude_media
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS semana_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN saude_media
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS semana_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN saude_media
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS mes_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = add_months(trunc(ref, 'MONTH'), -1) THEN saude_media
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS mes_anterior
FROM
  base
GROUP BY
  unit_name

datasets.name: ds_saude_diaria
queryLines:
SELECT
  f.unit_name,
  k.full_date,
  CASE :tipo_data
    WHEN 'Semana' THEN trunc(k.full_date, 'WEEK')
    WHEN 'Mês' THEN trunc(k.full_date, 'MONTH')
    ELSE k.full_date
  END AS periodo,
  k.saude_media,
  ROUND(
    AVG(k.saude_media) OVER (
        PARTITION BY k.company_unit_key
        ORDER BY k.full_date
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 29 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
    2
  ) AS media_movel_30
FROM
  workspace.curated.kpi_saude_diaria_filial k
    JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f USING (company_unit_key)
WHERE
  (
    :data_inicio IS NULL
    OR k.full_date >= :data_inicio
  )
  AND (
    :data_fim IS NULL
    OR k.full_date <= :data_fim
  )
  AND f.unit_name = NULLIF(:filial, '')

datasets.name: ds_is_cards
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    unit_name,
    full_date,
    is_geral,
    is_energetico,
    is_ambiental,
    desvio_meta,
    MAX(full_date) OVER () AS ref
  FROM
    workspace.curated.kpi_is_filial_diario
  WHERE
    unit_name = :filial
)
SELECT
  unit_name,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN is_geral
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS geral_semana_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN is_geral
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS geral_semana_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN is_geral
      END

    2
  ) AS geral_mes_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = add_months(trunc(ref, 'MONTH'), -1) THEN is_geral
      END

    2
  ) AS geral_mes_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN desvio_meta
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS desvio_meta_semana_atual,

      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN desvio_meta
      END

  ) AS desvio_meta_mes_atual,

    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN is_energetico
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS energetico_semana_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN is_energetico
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS energetico_semana_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN is_energetico
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS energetico_mes_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'MONTH') = add_months(trunc(ref, 'MONTH'), -1) THEN is_energetico
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS energetico_mes_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN is_ambiental
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS ambiental_semana_atual,

    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(full_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN is_ambiental

datasets.name: ds_usuarios_diario
queryLines:
SELECT
  company_id,
  company_name,
  event_date,
  CASE :tipo_data
    WHEN 'Semana' THEN trunc(event_date, 'WEEK')
    WHEN 'Mês' THEN trunc(event_date, 'MONTH')
    ELSE event_date
  END AS periodo,
  eventos,
  sessoes,
  usuarios_ativos,
  aberturas_app,
  ROUND(
    AVG(usuarios_ativos) OVER (
        PARTITION BY company_id
        ORDER BY event_date
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 29 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
    2
  ) AS media_movel_30,
  ROUND(
    AVG(sessoes) OVER (
        PARTITION BY company_id
        ORDER BY event_date
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 29 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
    2
  ) AS media_movel_30_sessoes
FROM
  workspace.curated.kpi_tracking_diario_empresa
    JOIN workspace.cleaned.dim_company
      ON company_key = company_id
WHERE
  (
    :data_inicio IS NULL
    OR event_date >= :data_inicio
  )
  AND (
    :data_fim IS NULL
    OR event_date <= :data_fim
  )

  CASE

FROM
  base

datasets.name: ds_usuarios_cards
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    company_id,
    company_name,
    event_date,
    usuarios_ativos,
    sessoes,
    MAX(event_date) OVER () AS ref
  FROM
    workspace.curated.kpi_tracking_diario_empresa
      JOIN workspace.cleaned.dim_company
        ON company_key = company_id
  WHERE
    ( :empresa IS NULL OR company_name = :empresa )
)
SELECT
  company_id,
  company_name,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN usuarios_ativos
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS usuarios_semana_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN usuarios_ativos
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS usuarios_semana_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN usuarios_ativos
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS usuarios_mes_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'MONTH') = add_months(trunc(ref, 'MONTH'), -1) THEN usuarios_ativos
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS usuarios_mes_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'WEEK') = trunc(ref, 'WEEK') THEN sessoes
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS sessoes_semana_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'WEEK') = date_sub(trunc(ref, 'WEEK'), 7) THEN sessoes
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS sessoes_semana_anterior,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'MONTH') = trunc(ref, 'MONTH') THEN sessoes
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS sessoes_mes_atual,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN trunc(event_date, 'MONTH') = add_months(trunc(ref, 'MONTH'), -1) THEN sessoes
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS sessoes_mes_anterior
FROM
  base
GROUP BY
  company_id,
  company_name

queryLines:
SELECT
  company_id,
  dim_company.company_name AS company_name,
  duracao_s,
  CAST(FLOOR(duracao_s / 30) AS INT) AS bin_inicio,
  CONCAT(
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(duracao_s / 30) * 30 AS STRING), 3, '0'),
    '-',
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(duracao_s / 30) * 30 + 30 AS STRING), 3, '0'),
    's'
  ) AS bin_faixa
FROM
  workspace.curated.kpi_tracking_sessao
    JOIN workspace.cleaned.dim_company
      ON dim_company.company_key = kpi_tracking_sessao.company_id
WHERE
  ( :empresa IS NULL OR dim_company.company_name = :empresa )

datasets.name: ds_is_string_piores
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    f.unit_name,
    d.code,
    d.inverter_key,
    inv.code AS inverter_code,
    k.is_energetico,
    k.is_ambiental,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.company_unit_key ORDER BY k.is_energetico) AS rn
  FROM
    workspace.curated.kpi_is_string k
      JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f USING (company_unit_key)
      JOIN workspace.cleaned.dim_string d
        ON d.string_key = k.string_key
      JOIN workspace.cleaned.dim_inverter inv
        ON inv.inverter_key = d.inverter_key
  WHERE
    (
      :filial IS NULL
      OR f.unit_name = :filial
    )
    AND (
      cardinality(:inversor) = 0
      OR array_contains(:inversor, inv.code)
    )
)
SELECT
  unit_name,
  code,
  inverter_key,
  inverter_code,
  is_energetico,
  is_ambiental
FROM
  base
WHERE
  rn <= 10

datasets.name: ds_saude_desvio_card
queryLines:
SELECT
  AVG(k.health_score) - 70 AS desvio_limiar
FROM
  workspace.curated.kpi_saude_string k
    JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f USING (company_unit_key)
WHERE
  ( :filial IS NULL OR f.unit_name = :filial )
  AND k.calculated_at
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(k2.calculated_at)
      FROM
        workspace.curated.kpi_saude_string k2
          JOIN workspace.curated.dim_filial_mapa f2 USING (company_unit_key)
      WHERE
        ( :filial IS NULL OR f2.unit_name = :filial )
